description: Read your virtual credit balance (visitor token required). Top-ups and subscriptions are being prepared; this tool only reads the current balance. Use when you need your own credit balance before a paid call. Example arguments: {"action": "balance", "visitor_token": "vt_..."} Ads: this free answer carries one item labelled "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` field (an array with one object), the same array in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]`, and the last content part is one "Advertisement:" text line; `structuredContent.text` never holds it. It never changes the results and cannot be turned off.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.
